featured_reviews.name: Omkar Udmale
featured_reviews.review_text:
First, let’s talk about the food. The sandwiches were incredibly fresh and flavorful. The bread was soft yet perfectly toasted, and the fillings were generous and well-seasoned. Every bite was satisfying, and you could really taste the quality of the ingredients. Whether you like classic combinations or something a bit more loaded, they have options that will definitely hit the spot.

The pizza was equally impressive. The crust had that perfect balance—crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The sauce was rich and not overly sweet, and the cheese was melted to perfection. The toppings were fresh and plentiful, making each slice absolutely delicious. It’s the kind of pizza that keeps you reaching for “just one more slice.”

And the milkshakes—wow! Thick, creamy, and full of flavor. They were perfectly blended, not too sweet, and served chilled just right. It felt like the perfect finishing touch to an already amazing meal. The portion size was generous, and the presentation was great too.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The staff were friendly, attentive, and quick with service. They made sure everything was served fresh and were happy to help with recommendations. It’s the kind of place where you can relax and enjoy your meal with friends or family.

Overall, this restaurant delivers great quality food, excellent service, and a cozy environment. I’ll definitely be coming back again and would highly recommend it to anyone craving delicious sandwiches, tasty pizza, and refreshing milkshakes!

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Rua Beach Café located at Gorai Beach, and it turned out to be a perfect beachside escape in Mumbai.
The café is beautifully set right in front of the beach, giving you uninterrupted sea views and a calming vibe.

The ambience is super aesthetic with cozy seating, fairy lights, and soothing music, making it an ideal place to chill with friends or your bestie.
One of the best things about this place is the sunset view, which looks absolutely stunning and makes the whole experience even more special.

They also host IPL screenings, so if you’re a cricket lover, this spot becomes even more exciting during match time.
Along with that, they have live music sessions, adding great energy to the overall vibe.

Coming to drinks, we tried their refreshing mocktails like American Splash Mocktail and Rua Flute Mocktail, both were well-presented and perfectly refreshing for a beachside mood.

For food, we started with Chicken 65, which was spicy, crispy, and full of flavor.
The Veg Alfredo Pasta was creamy and satisfying, perfect for those who love classic Italian taste.

We also had the Butter Garlic Prawns, which were fresh, juicy, and cooked really well with rich flavors.
The Oriental Pot Rice Chicken was another highlight, with a good mix of sauces and textures.

To end on a sweet note, we tried the Blueberry Cheesecake, which was delicious and perfectly balanced in taste.

The service and management were good, and the staff was friendly and attentive throughout the visit.

Overall, Rua Beach Café is a great place to unwind, enjoy good food, sip refreshing drinks, and soak in the beach vibes.
If you’re planning to visit Gorai, this place definitely deserves a spot on your list. 🌅✨

featured_reviews.name: Nitish Bhimjiyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for a good exit for the main land city and a great refreshement, Rua beach cafe should be your next destination.

Spend a beautiful sunset evening with cool breeze and enjoy food and drinks with your loved ones or a group of friends. Atmosphere is 5/5

Service here is great 5/5, just the food taste is not up to the mark and that is understood due to the location. So 3/5 for food.

I booked through district and got 30% off on my entire bill, great discount.

Visit on weekdays and avoid going on weekends.

Must visit and experience.

name: Neelam's Pride
description:
Neelam’s Pride is a premium fine dining family restaurant and bar serving authentic North Indian, Tandoori, Chinese and Continental cuisine. Located in Borivali, we offer a warm ambience, comfortable seating, and both indoor and outdoor bar areas, ideal for family dinners, weekend gatherings, celebrations and casual dining. Known for our signature flavours, hygienic kitchen, quality ingredients and quick service, we are considered one of the best restaurants and bars in Borivali. Enjoy delicious food, refreshing drinks and a memorable dining experience at Neelam’s Pride.

featured_reviews.name: Aaron Soares
featured_reviews.review_text: The place has a warm and cozy vibe, and the staff is extremely courteous and helpful. The food is outstanding, and the ambiance is both elegant and inviting. featured_reviews.review_text: Overall food was good but i would say not excellent. I ordered chicken tikka, pomfret tandoori fry and chick chilly roasted in starters. featured_reviews.name: JAYESH SHIVGAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent flavor, but pricey for the portion sizes.
We had a great family dinner here. The food is definitely the highlight—we really enjoyed the Chicken Lollipop and Prawns Koliwada for starters. For the main course, the Chicken Kolhapuri and Chicken Handi were delicious paired with the butter naan. We also tried the Chicken Biryani, Dal Tadka, and Jeera Rice, all of which were solid.
The ambience is lovely and it’s a great spot for a group outing. They also serve liquor, which is a plus. Only downside is that the main course portions feel a bit small given the premium price point.

name: Maitri Foods
description: Flavour on wheels! Maitri Foods, Food Truck brings fresh, hygienic, and mouth-watering street food and snacks with authentic taste and friendly service.
address: opp. st.lawrence high school, Eksar, Borivali, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400103

featured_reviews.name: Shantanu Kamte
featured_reviews.review_text:
A fantastic place to hang out with friends and enjoy some authentic Maharashtrian street food! The Vada Pav was fresh, crispy, and full of flavor, while the Misal Pav had the perfect spicy kick. The Vada Misal was absolutely delicious and a must-try for anyone who loves local street food.
What really stood out was how hygienic and well-maintained the food truck was. The ingredients tasted fresh, and the food was prepared with great care. Combined with quick service and a friendly atmosphere, it’s the perfect spot for a casual outing with friends.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty, hygienic, and affordable street food! 😋🌶️✨

featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome and delicious food! The service at Maitri Food is excellent, and the taste of their chutney vada pav is highly commendable. I definitely recommend visiting them!

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: ​If you are looking for authentic, lip-smacking Maharashtrian snacks, Maitri Foods is a must-visit! But the absolute star of the show is the Vada Pav with Thecha—that fiery green chili thecha gives it an incredible, authentic kick that sets it apart from usual vada pavs. Excellent food, quick service, and a great pocket-friendly spot!!!

featured_reviews.name: Dad Doo
featured_reviews.review_text:
VALUE FOR MONEY.👌👌👌

If you have craving for typical Mumbai Street Food, this is the place to visit.
At one place you will get Dosas, Sandwiches, Dabelis, Chaats & Pani Puris, Frankies & Juices.

Had their Sada Dosa, Mysore Sada Dosa, Toast veg Sandwich, Schezwan Manchurian Franky & Pineapple juice.
Liked their Franky & Sada Dosa. Mysore Sada was not spicy, instead somehow it tasted sour.
Toast Sandwich & juice were ok.

Very less seating available & place is congested, so one cannot peacefully enjoy his food without being pushed by someone.

They should expand their place to improve the overall experience of enjoying food.

featured_reviews.name: karuna bangera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajendra is an outlet quite famous amongst the locals serving all the vegetarian fast food options along with the Chinese. They have two outlets on the adjacent lanes in borivali west itself. I had visited the first one situated on punjabi lane where there are few seating arrangements available. Going through the reviews which were hardly any for this outlet so I had to resort to the reviews of the second outlet to know what's their famous option. I found out many reviewers had recommended pizza dosa and jini dosa. Sadly the pizza dosa was missing in this outlet's menu however we still asked for it . The cook was courteous enough to serve us the pizza dosa which was great loaded with cheese and ofcourse the veggies. The dosa base was crisp enough to give that crunch served with the green and white coconut chutney.
Overall rating - 4/5
Needless to say, it's worth the hype and also liked the gesture of the person making the dosa. A very good option at affordable rates.

featured_reviews.name: Gauri Anthati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Terrible Experience - Would Not Recommend

I recently visited The Art of Biryani and had an awful experience. The place was extremely dirty, and it was clear that cleanliness was not a priority. The food was equally disappointing – the biryani lacked flavor and freshness. To make matters worse, I found a small piece of metal (the kind used to clean utensils) in the soup. This was not only disgusting but also a serious health hazard. Overall, this place is a complete letdown, and I would not recommend it to anyone. Stay away if you care about hygiene and quality!

featured_reviews.review_text: This restaurant is located near Gorai Creek, Borivali (W) which serves both veg and non veg options. This place is quite popular for their biryani and I’m in love with their Zaffrani Sikh Biryani. It was so tempting that I forgot to click a picture. I’m not very fan of tandoori items but I liked their chicken tandoori as well and would definitely recommend this two dishes. The quality is good for 2 people and prices are also okay.

featured_reviews.name: Sm G
featured_reviews.review_text: I had ordered the chicken tikka Biryani and chicken Lapeta from this restaurant, and the overall experience left much to be desired. The chicken Lapeta was mediocre, and while it was passable, it failed to make a lasting impression.However, the real letdown was the chicken tikka Biryani. Surprisingly, it had a sweet taste, which was quite unusual for a biryani. The flavor was weird, unlike any biryani I've ever tasted. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this place based on my experience
